data.predicted_state: Show predicted brightness during Hue fades
data.z2m_color_modes: Fix colors of full-color Zigbee2MQTT lights

data_description.predicted_state: A Hue bridge reports a fade's end brightness as soon as it starts, and where a stopped fade halted late or never. With this on, Home Assistant shows the brightness at the start, where a stop halted it, and the end once the fade has run. Turn it off to show what the bridge reports.
data_description.z2m_color_modes: Zigbee2MQTT tells Home Assistant a full-color light has one color mode, so Home Assistant keeps showing the old color whenever the bulb reports in the other. With this on, device_side sets each such light's and group's Home Assistant override in Zigbee2MQTT's settings to announce both. Turn it off to remove those overrides.

get_attributes.name: Get attributes
get_attributes.description: Get brightness, color temp, and color (RGB, HS, XY), even if lights are off, and any running on/off timer. Returns one record per target.

lower_brightness.name: Lower brightness
lower_brightness.description: Starts brightness falling at a steady speed until it reaches 0% or the minimum. Stop halts it where it is. Built for hold-to-dim buttons.

sweep_time.name: Sweep time
sweep_time.description: Seconds a full range takes: 0% to 100%, or once around the color wheel for hue. The speed is the same wherever the move starts.

limit.name: Minimum brightness
limit.description: Brightness to stop at instead of 0%, in percent. The light turns off at 0%. Choose 0.4% or more to keep it on.

lower_hue.name: Lower hue
lower_hue.description: Starts the hue angle decreasing at a steady speed: red to magenta to blue to green, wrapping at 360°. It cycles until stop halts it.

sweep_time.name: Sweep time
sweep_time.description: Seconds a full range takes: 0% to 100%, or once around the color wheel for hue. The speed is the same wherever the move starts.

lower_saturation.name: Lower saturation
lower_saturation.description: Starts saturation falling at a steady speed, paler toward white, until it reaches 0% or the minimum. Stop halts it where it is.

sweep_time.name: Sweep time
sweep_time.description: Seconds a full range takes: 0% to 100%, or once around the color wheel for hue. The speed is the same wherever the move starts.

limit.name: Minimum saturation
limit.description: Saturation to stop at instead of 0%, in percent.

raise_brightness.name: Raise brightness
raise_brightness.description: Starts brightness rising at a steady speed until it reaches 100% or the maximum, turning the light on. Stop halts it where it is. Built for hold-to-brighten buttons.

sweep_time.name: Sweep time
sweep_time.description: Seconds a full range takes: 0% to 100%, or once around the color wheel for hue. The speed is the same wherever the move starts.

limit.name: Maximum brightness
limit.description: Brightness to stop at instead of 100%, in percent.

raise_hue.name: Raise hue
raise_hue.description: Starts the hue angle increasing at a steady speed: red to yellow to green to blue, wrapping at 360°. It cycles until stop halts it.

sweep_time.name: Sweep time
sweep_time.description: Seconds a full range takes: 0% to 100%, or once around the color wheel for hue. The speed is the same wherever the move starts.

raise_saturation.name: Raise saturation
raise_saturation.description: Starts saturation rising at a steady speed, toward a richer color, until it reaches 100% or the maximum. Stop halts it where it is.

sweep_time.name: Sweep time
sweep_time.description: Seconds a full range takes: 0% to 100%, or once around the color wheel for hue. The speed is the same wherever the move starts.

limit.name: Maximum saturation
limit.description: Saturation to stop at instead of 100%, in percent.

set_attributes.name: Set attributes
set_attributes.description: Set brightness, color temp, or color without changing on/off state.

set_scene.name: Set scene
set_scene.description: Set a Hue scene without turning on its lights.

stop.name: Stop
stop.description: Stops every raise and lower in flight on the target, whichever attribute, where it is now.

turn_off_for.name: Turn off for
turn_off_for.description: Devices turn off, then on again after a delay. To cancel the timed on, send a regular turn off.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to stay off before turning back on.

turn_on_for.name: Turn on for
turn_on_for.description: Devices turn on, then off again after a delay. To cancel the timed off, send a regular turn on (on ZHA, a turn off).

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to stay on before turning off.

brightness.name: Brightness value
brightness.description: Brightness to turn on at, from 1 (minimum) to 255 (maximum). Lights only.

color_temp_kelvin.name: Color temperature
color_temp_kelvin.description: Color temperature in Kelvin to turn on at. Lights only.

hs_color.name: Hue/Sat color
hs_color.description: Color in hue/sat format to turn on at. A list of two numbers: hue 0-360, saturation 0-100. Lights only.

rgb_color.name: Color
rgb_color.description: Color in RGB format to turn on at. A list of three integers between 0 and 255. Lights only.

xy_color.name: XY-color
xy_color.description: Color in XY format to turn on at. A list of two decimal numbers between 0 and 1. Lights only.

transition.name: Transition
transition.description: Seconds the light takes to reach the brightness and color above. Lights only.
